messages:
sarah: Quick sync — proposing staged rollout for structured-output / function-calling compat.
sarah: TL;DR: server flag `redwood.feature.structured_output_v2` -> start 5% global canary for 24h, fallback to legacy if errors. Client SDKs: want guidance on default behavior (opt-in vs opt-out) and per-audience sizes.
mike: +1 on gradual server canary. Suggest splitting by client type: web 8%, mobile 3% — web traffic is easier to monitor.
julia: We need explicit guardrails: telemetry for schema validation failures, automatic fallback to legacy model on parse errors, and a circuit-breaker if error rate > 2% for 10m.
alex: Heads-up on SDK changes: current plan in SDK repo is to expose a toggle `enableStructuredOutput` and default to false (opt-in). I prefer default=false so older clients don’t unexpectedly change behavior.
olivia: From PM side — customers expect structured output to be opt-in for now. Default=false seems fine for public SDKs, but for Redwood-hosted internal apps we can flip earlier.
devops-bot: deploy reminder: canary job `canary/so-v2` scheduled at 03:00 UTC — rolling 5% across 120 hosts
mike: For metrics, please ensure we tag requests with `so_v2=true|false` and `so_v2_source=server/client` so we can split rollouts/rollback safely.
julia: Also add a `so_v2_parse_error` counter and capture the failing payload id (no PII) so we can reproduce.
sarah: Agree on metrics. Updated proposal: server-side 5% global for 24h (auto-increase to 20% if healthy for 72h). Client-side: SDK default=false (opt-in), but add a remote-flag audience that can be used for internal apps and partner customers.
Alex: small SDK snippet for devs — use this:
```js
// opt-in example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ enableStructuredOutput: true })
const res = await client.generate({ prompt, structured: true })
```
And remote config key is `feature.structured_output_client_enable`.
mike: I'll add a rollout YAML for infra ops. Draft:
```yaml
feature_flag: structured_output_v2
server_canary: 0.05
server_duration: 24h
auto_scale_if_healthy: true
auto_scale_window: 72h
fallback: legacy-model
client_defaults:
  sdk_default: false
  remote_audience:
    internal: 1.0
    partners: 0.1
    public_web: 0.0
```
julia: I'll wire up alerts: pager if `so_v2_parse_error` rate > 0.5% over 5m and set a runbook to rollback flag.
sarah: One more: add a test probe that sends a curated prompt set every 5m to canary cohort and checks structured schema + semantic correctness (we have existing eval harness). If probe fails, rollback automatically.
olivia: Good. Can we also add a short note in the changelog / release notes: breaking changes, client migration steps, and example prompts.
mike: I'll open PRs: infra rollout + SDK opt-in flag change + test probe. Assigning to @julia for alerts and @alex for SDK review.
sarah: Thanks — tagging for ack: @mike @julia @alex @olivia. If no objections by EOD I'll kick off canary tomorrow morning :thumbsup:
mike: ACK, will start infra PR today.
julia: ACK, alerting + dashboard in progress.
alex: ACK, SDK PR soon.
devops-bot: canary job `canary/so-v2` queued (job id c-4921) — ETA 6h
sarah: Perfect, closing the loop. Anything else?
thread_text: Quick sync — proposing staged rollout for structured-output / function-calling compat. Plan: server 5% canary, SDK opt-in default=false, telemetry and guardrails, test probe, auto-rollback rules.
